name: Idris II of Morocco
contribution: An Arab Emir who was the son of Idris I, the founder of the Idrisid dynasty.

checks.lead: Idris II (Arabic: إدريس الثاني) (August 791 – August 828), was an Arab Emir who was the son of Idris I, the founder of the Idrisid dynasty. He was born in Walili two months after the death of his father. He succeeded his father Idris I in 803.
